sections.heading: Oversight
sections.content: A London-based Asset Management Company established its office in Islamabad in 2021. The office has seen rapid growth over the last 12 months and continues to grow in 2026. The company also provides middle and back-office services to our other offices in Monaco and Switzerland, while London remains the operational hub of the entire group. In 2021, the group established FGK Back Office Services in Islamabad as an offshore center to support its London operations. FGK Back Office Services (Private) Limited is engaged in Back Office Services and is registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. The company commenced operations in November 2021 with the strategic ambition of providing Back Office Services to companies operating in the financial and banking sectors, both domestically and internationally. Its services include Data Management, Operations Support, Accounting and Reporting, and Portfolio Management. Considering the expansion of our business operations, we are looking for an HR and Admin Executive who will be responsible for managing human resources functions and administrative tasks to ensure smooth and efficient operations within the organisation.

sections.heading: Job Description
sections.content: Responsible for overseeing recruitment, payroll, employee relations, and office administration, including procurement, vendor coordination, and facilities management. The role ensures smooth day-to-day operations, adherence to company policies, and effective implementation of HR and administrative processes. Key responsibilities include:

sections.heading: Human Resources Management
list: Manage end-to-end recruitment processes using ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems), including job postings, applicant screening, interview scheduling, and onboarding.
Prepare and maintain accurate employee records, including personal data, contracts, and performance evaluations.
Handle employee onboarding and orientation programs to ensure smooth onboarding into the company.
Manage payroll processing, attendance records, and leave management. Support payroll administration by verifying attendance records and updating employee information in HR systems.
Assist in performance management and appraisals.
Maintain and update HR policies and ensure compliance with labour laws and company regulations.
Address employee queries regarding compensation, benefits, and workplace issues.
Organize training and development sessions for staff, assist in conducting employee engagement activities to promote a positive work environment.

sections.heading: Administration and Office Management:
list: Oversee daily office operations to maintain a productive and efficient work environment.
Manage office supplies inventories, place orders as needed, and ensure uninterrupted operations.
Coordinate with vendors and service providers for office maintenance, repairs, utilities, and equipment management.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of office spaces, adhering to hygiene standards.
Manage office equipment, including maintenance and repairs, to ensure smooth functionality.
Identify office requirements and ensure timely procurement of supplies and equipment, maintaining cost-effectiveness through vendor evaluation and contract negotiation.
Establish and maintain relationships with suppliers and service providers to secure favorable terms and agreements.
Maintain accurate records of purchases, pricing, vendor agreements, and office assets to ensure proper utilization and budget tracking.
Conduct market research to identify quality products and obtain competitive quotes for procurement.
Develop and implement administrative systems to enhance operational efficiency and streamline processes.
Assist in organizing company events, meetings, and conferences, including logistics and coordination.

sections.heading: Qualifications & Skills:
list: Bachelor’s degree in human resource management, Business Administration, or related field.
Familiarity with ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems) and HR management software is highly desirable.
Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience as an HR and Admin Executive or similar role.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Knowledge of labour laws and regulations.
Attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
Fluent in both written and spoken English
Self-starter and motivated
Willing to work as part of a team

sections.heading: Other Information
list: Benefits: EOBI, Gratuity, Medical Insurance IPD & OPD as per company policy.
Timing: Winter: 10:00 AM to 07:00PM Summer: 09:00 Am to 06:00PM.
Working Days: From Monday to Friday.
Work Location: In person

sections.content: If you believe your background meets the criteria, Submit your application using the form under this section by filling out all required fields and attaching your CV and cover letter.
